question: Who may mark a knowledge-base row or collective agreement is_public, and what review precedes publication beyond the organization?
decision: Internal sharing is tenant-restricted by default. Cross-tenant/public publication of knowledge or collective-agreement documents requires a designated org publishing officer, independent privacy/legal review of the exact version, redaction/rights verification and an auditable second approver. A published item has an explicit audience scope and revision; withdrawal immediately revokes future access and invalidates derived indexes/caches as feasible.
originalProposedDecision: Only the org's officers or admins may set is_public, and only with a second approver from the same org. Default false. Unpublishing is immediate.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
